changelog: Native Windows Taskbar Scanner Sync: Proactively scans open interactive desktop applications (Antigravity IDE, Brave, Spotify, WhatsApp, Deskflow, etc.) and synchronizes real-time telemetry across all teammates.
Eliminated Static App Duplication: Each user workstation now broadcasts its genuine running taskbar processes instead of mirroring fallback presets.
Robust Multi-Image Messaging: Optimized image compression and sanitized attachments pipeline ensures multi-photo messages deliver instantly without breaching Cloud Firestore document limits.
High-Contrast Chat & DM Visibility: Fixed white-on-white text in personal chat and channel lists, ensuring teammate names and unread counts are always crystal clear in light and dark themes.
